channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump escalates trade conflict, moves to block many Canadian goods from US
item.description: President Donald Trump intensified economic measures against Canada following its retaliatory tariffs on U.S. goods.

item.title: Shelton defeats Alcaraz in late-night US Open marathon, advances to face Tiafoe
item.description: Ben Shelton ended Carlos Alcaraz's title defense in the latest-finishing match in U.S. Open history, winning 6-7, 6-1, 6-3, 1-6, 7-6.

item.title: Juror in Lindsay Clancy trial cites doubt after mistrial
item.description: A juror explained that lingering doubts prevented a guilty verdict in the Lindsay Clancy case.

item.title: Oil reaches $100 per barrel amid fresh U.S.-Iran attacks
item.description: Crude prices climbed to a seven-week high after U.S. strikes on Iranian tankers prompted Tehran's retaliation.
